description: SEMP_ABUSE_REPORT carrying the observation_record_abuse category. Used when a consumer detects misbehavior in published trust-gossip observation records themselves (oversized records, evidence-hash mismatches, hostile evidence content, fabricated metrics, systematic publication of unverifiable assessments). The report flows from a user (or the user's home server on the user's behalf) to the home server over an already-authenticated session, so the wire shape does not carry its own signature; the session identifies the reporting user.

vectors.description: Abuse report whose category targets the trust-gossip observation record itself. The envelope_metadata evidence shape carries the postmark ids of the published observations the consumer rejected and the observation window the publisher purported to summarize.

report_json.description: Publisher emitted two trust-observation records whose evidence_hash did not match the bytes returned by evidence_uri.
